major_cooldowns.name: Pillar of Frost
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown every 45 seconds together with Reaper's Mark, your potion and any on-use trinket, entering the window at zero or one Empower Rune Weapon charge so the tier set charge does not overcap, and open it from an empty GCD in a macro with an on-GCD ability to maximise casts inside the 12 seconds.

major_cooldowns.name: Reaper's Mark
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Macro it into every Pillar of Frost on the shared 45-second cooldown, and track the two Exterminate procs it leaves behind: they hand you two Killing Machines and 1-Rune Obliterates, so avoid double-stacking Killing Machine while they are pending.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 439843 is the current cast id; 434765 / 436304 / 439594 are the passive and splash components.

major_cooldowns.name: Breath of Sindragosa
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pool Runic Power into the Pillar of Frost window and open it there with well over the 60 Runic Power it costs, then run the standard priority: every Killing Machine and Rime spend extends the 8 seconds, up to 30.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1249658 is the current cast and self-aura id; 155166 and 1234304 were not observed in the sampled parse.

major_cooldowns.name: Frostwyrm's Fury
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it inside every Pillar of Frost window, then recall the wyrm roughly 12 seconds later while Pillar is still up and the Chosen of Frostbrood Haste buff has elapsed; the recall is off the GCD, and saving it for the next Pillar is not worth the timing risk.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 279302 is the talent cast; 1265384 is the Apex recall cast observed alongside it.

major_cooldowns.name: Empower Rune Weapon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Two charges on a 30-second recharge: press it before you cap at two, whenever you have no Killing Machine and cannot spend Runic Power, and inside Pillar of Frost with Obliteration for extra free Obliterates; with the tier set, Pillar and Breath each grant a charge, so start that window at zero or weave a cast between Pillar and Breath.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 47568 is the cast id; 1231100 was not observed in the sampled parse.

major_cooldowns.name: Raise Dead
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Off the GCD, so fold it into the Pillar of Frost macro and re-send it every second Pillar window.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Shell
defensives.usage_rule: Pre-cast it into predictable magic damage; the absorb feeds Runic Power, so press it at a 40+ Runic Power deficit to keep the gain.
defensives.id_note: 48707 is the self cast and aura; 444741 / 410358 are the targeted variants.

defensives.name: Icebound Fortitude
defensives.usage_rule: 30% damage reduction and stun immunity for 8 seconds: hold it for scripted physical hits and stun mechanics.

defensives.name: Lichborne
defensives.usage_rule: 10 seconds of Undead with 6% Leech and immunity to Charm, Fear and Sleep: press it for fear mechanics or as steady self-healing through sustained raid damage.

defensives.name: Death Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Emergency heal for 50% of max health; take the 15-second healing absorb when a healer cannot reach you in time.
defensives.id_note: 48743 is the cast observed in the sampled parse; 443609 is the weaker variant.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Zone
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it under the raid ahead of a heavy magic burst for 15% magic damage reduction over 6 seconds.
defensives.id_note: 51052 is the cast id; 145629 is the aura it applies.

rules.description: Open Empower Rune Weapon into Pillar of Frost
rules.action: Open with Empower Rune Weapon into Obliterate, then Reaper's Mark, then Pillar of Frost with potion, trinket and Raise Dead, then Breath of Sindragosa, then Frostwyrm's Fury.

rules.description: Reaper's Mark macroed with Pillar of Frost
rules.action: Macro Reaper's Mark into Pillar of Frost: both sit on 45 seconds, so send the Mark as Pillar comes up and every Mark lands in a Pillar window.

rules.description: Breath of Sindragosa opened inside Pillar of Frost
rules.action: Only start Breath of Sindragosa once Pillar of Frost is up; the exception is a fight ending inside 20 seconds.

rules.description: Frostwyrm's Fury inside Pillar of Frost
rules.action: Send Frostwyrm's Fury in every Pillar of Frost window and spend the recall about 12 seconds later, still inside Pillar, after the 12-second Haste buff has elapsed.

rules.description: Killing Machine procs spent on Obliterate
rules.action: Obliterate is your filler while Killing Machine is up: press it at 3+ Runes, and consume immediately at two stacks. Under 3 Runes spend a Rime Howling Blast or a 70+ Runic Power Frost Strike first, and swap to Frostscythe from 3 targets.

rules.description: Empower Rune Weapon without capping Killing Machine
rules.action: Press Empower Rune Weapon when you hold no Killing Machine and cannot spend Runic Power, or when its second charge is about to cap; never generate a proc while you already sit at two stacks. Inside Pillar of Frost with Obliteration it is free value, so send it there at one stack and 2 or fewer Runes.

rules.description: Rime procs spent on Howling Blast
rules.action: Consume every Rime proc with Howling Blast before your next Frost Strike or Glacial Advance can overwrite it.

rules.description: Breath of Sindragosa opened near max Runic Power
rules.action: Stop spending Runic Power inside the last four GCDs before Breath of Sindragosa and open it near cap, not at the bare 60 it costs, so the window does not drop early.
Spend Killing Machine on Frostscythe from 3 targets up; below that Obliterate is the stronger spender.

rules.description: Glacial Advance replaces Frost Strike at 3+ targets
rules.action: Dump Runic Power into Glacial Advance from 3 targets up, facing the pack from its edge; keep Frost Strike for single target and for Frostbane procs at 5 stacks of Razorice.

source_summary: Frost Death Knight builds every cooldown around Pillar of Frost: Reaper's Mark is macroed into it on the shared 45-second cycle, Breath of Sindragosa is opened inside it on pooled Runic Power, and Frostwyrm's Fury plus its Apex recall are both spent in that window. Empower Rune Weapon runs on charge management rather than on cooldown, pressed before it caps at two and used inside Pillar to feed Killing Machine, with the tier set charges from Pillar and Breath demanding you enter the window at zero or one. Between windows the rotation is proc-driven: Killing Machine into Obliterate or Frostscythe, Rime into Howling Blast, and leftover Runic Power into Frost Strike or, from 3 targets, Glacial Advance.
